- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.6) — reduce forecast peak values by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (sentiment drops below 0.5) — adjust downward by 3–8% to avoid overcorrection.
- Model tends to overreact to recent highs — apply a 1–2 day lag correction for price peaks.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 2–5% unless sentiment is strong.
- In low sentiment (sentiment < 0.3), forecast should be conservative — cap upward movement at 3% from prior day.
- Forecast horizon 30d: avoid over-optimistic tail ends — reduce final 5–7 days by 2–5% if sentiment is weak or trending down.
